rules.description: Total annual income must exceed Personal Allowance to owe tax
rules.reason_if_failed: Your total income is below the Personal Allowance (£12,570). You do not owe tax on your pension.

rules.description: Applicant must have pension income (State or private)
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for people receiving State Pension or private pension income.

rules.description: Applicant must not have foreign income
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use this tool if you have foreign income. Contact HMRC for advice.

rules.description: Applicant must not receive Marriage Allowance
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use this tool if you receive Marriage Allowance. Contact HMRC for advice.

rules.description: Applicant must not receive Blind Person's Allowance
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use this tool if you receive Blind Person's Allowance. Contact HMRC for advice.

rules.description: Applicant must be UK resident or have UK pension provider
rules.reason_if_failed: You may only pay UK tax if you're a UK resident or receive pension from a UK provider.

explanation_template: Income tax on pension: {outcome}. Total income: £{total_annual_income}. Personal Allowance: £12,570. Tax owed: {tax_owed}. Payment method: {payment_method}.

edge_cases.description: Life expectancy less than a year due to serious illness
edge_cases.action: Special rules apply: may take entire pension as tax-free lump sum if under 75 and below lump sum allowance. Contact pension provider and HMRC.

edge_cases.description: Taking pension worth up to £10,000 as lump sum
edge_cases.action: Small pot rules apply: 25% tax-free, remainder taxed. Up to 3 from personal pensions, unlimited from workplace.

edge_cases.description: Total private pensions worth £30,000 or less
edge_cases.action: Trivial commutation rules apply: 25% tax-free. All payments must be within 12 months.

edge_cases.description: Taking large amount from pension in one go
edge_cases.action: Warning: May pay Income Tax at higher rate. May owe extra tax at end of tax year. Consider spreading withdrawals.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives abroad but receives UK pension
edge_cases.action: Check double-taxation agreement between UK and country of residence. May pay tax in both countries or only one.

edge_cases.description: Payment made outside government tax rules
edge_cases.action: Warning: Unauthorised payments taxed at up to 55%. Includes early withdrawal before 55, loans against pension. Contact HMRC immediately.
Must complete Self Assessment tax return. Declare all income including State Pension and private pensions.
